Episode 241: Rescue (5)
First to fall into the pit was Luna's meteor shower.
Sanna had just closed her eyes, focusing on her prayers again, and Ailan and Bivol were unable to react. To them, it merely felt like a flash of light.
If Temar Bement hadn't shot his dark energy at the meteor shower at that moment, everyone in the pit would have suffered fatal injuries.
"Kahaak!"
Temar Bement shouted, taking his stance.
Though he managed to collide his dark energy with the falling meteor shower, it merely scattered his attack.
It neither slowed down nor did the condensed energy become distorted.
Temar Bement had no choice but to swing his sword again, gritting his teeth.
"Cough!"
Temar Bement felt a sensation of his head going white as soon as his sword touched the meteor shower.
He felt like his body would crumble from the intense shock, something he'd never experienced before.
Although he looked like a young man, just like Temar from a thousand years ago, he was nothing but an incomplete mind, only a few years old.
He had undergone various training with other minds and the royal experts, but none of them had Luna's destructive power.
That's why the royal family had planned to train him slowly over time.
They intended to awaken Temar Lunakandel's memories gradually and raise his martial arts level by facing strong opponents in sequence.
"Temar!"
Shieit, tkakagak-!
As the meteor shower exploded, Temar bounced around the pit like a ball, spitting blood.
The others heard the dull sound of cracks forming in the stone walls, and Temar heard the crunching sound of his bones breaking all over his body.
It was a sound he'd never heard before.
Barely regaining his consciousness and opening his eyes, the first thing Temar Bement saw was his two legs, twisted and bent at odd angles.
"Huh?"
For some reason, his regeneration ability wasn't activating.
It was because of the red energy mixed in with the meteor shower.
Temar Bement's battered body seemed to be on fire, as the red energy flickered all over him.
"Temar, are you okay...!"
The emperor shouted.
Thanks to Temar taking the meteor shower with his whole body, he had avoided significant damage.
However, the emperor's eyes widened in shock, wondering whether Temar Bement had completely vanished.
Though the royal family had survived without destruction since ancient times, they had never actively participated in any of the major wars of each era.
They had fled hastily during the wars of the ancient kings, hid during the conquest wars of the later kings, and remained hidden behind the mask of mysticism during the thousand-year wars between
Lunakandel and Zipl.
Just like now, always scheming from behind, he has never faced off against real, powerful opponents who are outside of the norm.
That's why the Emperor couldn't understand why Temar Bement had crumbled with just one blow.
He possessed not only the real left arm of Temar but also the brilliant heart of the Qingming tribe's king.
Temar Bement reflexively tried to get up but fell back, naturally looking up at the sky.
A dazzling light struck Temar Bement's blurred vision.
For a moment, Temar mistook that light for warm sunlight.
But the identity of that light was another falling meteor, even more violent than Luna's sword that had just torn the pit.
"Blood, dodge ..."
Now, Temar Bement couldn't throw himself.
The Bebol, who had to protect Ailan, had already collapsed, losing half his body to the first attack, and Sanna was just screaming.
If that falls into the pit, it's over ...
Temar Bement, the belatedly awakened Emperor, and even Sanna all thought the same.
Especially for Sanna, it was hard to believe that such a disaster had occurred, even under Luke's protection.
"Witch!"
With a screech and a thud, at the very moment when Sanna closed her eyes tightly, Luke, who was in the air, fell into the pit like thunder and blocked Jin's meteor.
But no matter how divine Luke was, Jin was also at the same level.
If they faced each other head-on, they could fend off meteor-level attacks back and forth, but in this unstable stance, taking it hastily, even Luke would take a hit.
"Priest Luke!"
Luke furrowed his brows and scattered the fragments of the meteor.
"Why are you so surprised, Witch? You won't die so easily anyway."
With a choking sound, Sanna suddenly coughed up black blood and collapsed on the ground.
"Haak, ha. The magic, red energy, and power possessed by Jin Runekandel interfered with my prayers. So I couldn't open the dimensional gate on time."
"Is your condition very bad?"
"It's the worst since I entered the human world."
Sanna wiped her mouth and looked at Temar Bement.
Even as his entire body was crumpled like a rag, Temar's real left arm remained unscathed.
"As you said, Priest, I won't die easily, so please prioritize protecting Ailan. If I die, no one can use Temar's left arm."
"How much time do you need?"
"Shortest, fifteen minutes... if it's delayed, thirty minutes."
"The reason for the delay is when magic and red energy penetrate into the pit, as just happened?"
"That's right."
"Then I will make sure that never happens. You must finish within fifteen minutes."
Luke leaped back to the outside of the pit, swinging his hand once. Following his touch, an even thicker shield enveloped the pit.
Two air fortresses in the sky.
Jin and Luna on the ground.
As Sanna said, it was the worst.
There was no memory of facing such formidable enemies all at once, neither during the days as the King of the Dead's warrior, nor after joining the Sun God's faith.
Pibil and Patil's cannons fired at Luke. At the same time, a fierce lightning attack spiraled around Luke's broadsword.
King of the Dead's Warrior's Skill
Thunder God Sword - Extreme
Two enemy cannons and a sword clashed.
Luke didn't have the option to avoid the air fortress's cannons, like Jin or Luna.
He had to protect the pit, so all he could do was deflect.
"Kahaaa!"
The blue storm pierced the enemy's cannon and continued forward.
Luke's sword energies, spiraling without rest, intertwined to form a point.
A point condensed with the martial arts of the celestial warrior. That sword made the enemy's cannon explode like water from the inside, continuously.
The explosion scattered the enemy's cannon, affecting Pibil's as well.
Patil's shot twisted and pushed Pibil's cannon aside.
"Damn it, these monster bastards!"
Rakiman spat out angrily.
It wasn't the maximum output, but it was a simultaneous firing from two air fortresses. As an enemy clan, the fact that he could deflect it while protecting his allies was astonishing.
Furthermore, Luke was closest to the air fortress, so he felt the effects of the enemy's electromagnetic waves the most.
Though his body must have felt heavy as if underwater, his sword was only swift and sharp like a light.
"Simart, Rakiman brethren. Can you hear?"
The enemy clan's unstable communication device was restored.
"Yes, Bakarun brethren. You have decided to abandon Eltiyet and retreat."

"That's right. Eltiyet has fallen into Bamel's Union's hands. There's no need to continue fighting here. Though the Bamel Union and the Sun God's faith are at odds, the risks of keeping the battlefield for their mutual destruction are too high."
"I agree. But it's a shame to just retreat."
"What would you like to do?"
"Retreat, yes, but hit the Sun God's faith and then pull back."
{Only the Sun God's religion?}
{Yes, brethren. The current situation is such that, unless we fight each other to the death, either we or the Barmel Alliance can retreat whenever we want.}
The aerial fortresses and fleet were as mobile as humans could not chase, and Jin and Luna could never be caught if they decided to run away.
But as Shimat said, the Sun God's religion couldn't do that. They had to fight, whether they liked it or not, until the portal was complete.

{If we only attack the Sun God's religion, Jin Lunkandel and Baekgyeong will not necessarily attack us. We don't know how they found us here, but it's clear that their purpose wasn't to challenge us in the first place. Also, Jin Lunkandel has to take care of the captured Eltiot, so there's no reason for them to not cooperate.}
Bakarun nodded.
Shimat's opinion was a scenario where both the royal family that had treated them like dogs and the Sun God's religion trying to save them would get their just deserts.
{Do that, transfer all the energy used for the cannons to the shields right now. The whole fleet, support Jin Lunkandel and Baekgyeong.}
The enemy's electric cannons had decreased.
Luke caught his breath, retrieving the energy of his Lightning Sword scattered around.
He expected the enemy's electric cannons to drop again, but that was not the case.
As the dust and red electric sparks subsided, what appeared before Luke's eyes was Jin.
"...Jin Lunkandel."
"Sun God's Priest, Luke. You dare use lightning, the one who has tainted the honor of the Demon King."
Luke didn't answer, looking alternately at Jin and the sky.
The aerial fortresses and fleets were moving, appearing to support Jin.
Jin was also aware of that.
'Shimat's decision, huh? He made a good one this time too.'
Grinning, Jin made eye contact with Luke.
"I can see what's going on, Luke. You guys messed up some plan of the enemy tribe before we arrived, didn't you? I never thought they would decide to attack you only, not me."
Luke deliberately answered slowly to buy time. The portal would be completed in just 12 more minutes.
But Jin was not going to miss the fact that the Sun God's religion needed time.
Jin exploded the lightning gathered at his sword's hilt before Luke even opened his mouth.
Demon King's Swordsmanship 10th Sword Secret
Demon King's Dominance Sword - Dog

Before the Creation, when the Demon King's Dominance Sword was unsheathed, blue lightning spread the Demon King's majesty all around, but now, golden lightning instantly stained the entire battlefield.
That energy made the vast ground crumble and boil like tofu. Even the enemy's aerial fortresses' electric waves couldn't stop the spread of the energy of the Demon King's Dominance Sword.
The enemy tribes watching this scene from the sky unwittingly swallowed their dry saliva.
Had they
not decided to attack only Luke, they would have had to endure that terrifying power themselves.

"You, on the other hand, have made a very wrong decision. Before I arrived here, you should have left behind our clan's first ancestor's body and the tattered remnants of the royal family you had torn apart."
